thesis: PGNY is a profitable healthcare-benefits name with accelerating growth (YoY revenue +1.4%/+5.3%/+8.9%, net income +61%/+64%/+89%), FCF 195.1M against debt 25.9M, and forward P/E 14.8. It is in a shallow, low-volume (ratio 0.85) pullback inside a post-earnings uptrend, and healthcare (XLV) is one of the few sectors holding up in a risk-off tape. Take it only on a dip into the 34.60-35.50 zone. Entry is the zone midpoint 35.10 and the technical stop and target are kept unchanged (R/R about 2.2 from the midpoint, about 1.72 at the 35.45 last price).
invalidation: A daily close below the 33.34 post-earnings swing low (stop 33.10) invalidates the setup, and a close under the 20-day SMA near 32.76 means the breakout has failed.
key_risks: Broad risk-off regime (VIX 31.37 at the 99.5th percentile, QQQ below its 50/200-day averages) can drag even defensive names
Resistance at the 37.21 52-week high is only about 1.76 above the last price, and the 39.50 target is a measured extension rather than a packet level
Price is extended (RSI 67, 8.2% above SMA20) with three lower closes; the post-earnings gap could fill toward 33
Latest-quarter revenue fell sequentially (341.3M vs 350.5M) and the packet has no guidance detail; SEC quarterly series has gaps
Mean analyst target 37.75 is only about 6% above the close
Adds to a healthcare-heavy book, so it is a correlated rather than independent bet (lessons item 6)
Next earnings date is not in the packet (estimated early Feb 2027, outside the horizon)
